property_summary: For any caller and target address, only the original deployer (the admin, the contract creator) can successfully change owner via setOwner; the mutant lets the current owner do so, so there exist caller/target inputs where the reference keeps owner unchanged (call reverts) but the mutant allows the call and changes owner.
change_summary: Change onlyAdmin require to check msg.sender == owner so only the current owner can call setOwner, altering who can change owner and thus the resulting owner after setOwner.
